value.rationale: The stationary shape is measurable through excess kurtosis, with a natural sharp spatial-dimension threshold and exact tuning parameter, not an arbitrary tabulated case. High-dimensional angular orthogonality coexists with persistent radial fluctuations from stochastic run durations; the conditional CLT quantifies the next-order randomness and distinguishes the correct Gaussian variance mixture from an incorrect deterministic Gaussian approximation. The result gives a motivated asymptotic and shape benchmark for active particles and has clear non-noisy and fixed-rate limits.
